reviews.x: Ordered this to heat my hair during a color extraction.  Gets plenty hot, fast, without being too hot.  Totally covered all of my hair/head. Comfortable.  Looks a little silly, but who really cares? Arrived in packaging that was a little beat up, but product works great!  Will definitely use when needing heat for conditioning, coloring, or extracting.

Since doing this I have on a search for a good heated hair conditioning cap. I read many review for many different caps and this one had by far the best reviews. I was still leery because of all the caps this was the only one with good reviews and i didn't want to waste money, but as my hair was getting drier by the weeks

I purchased this cap b/c I refuse to invest in another rolling hair dryer, which only last on avg 1-2 yrs! Since I am a naturalista, I only need heat for deep conditioning, so this cap was a cost-effective and smart choice. The cap is easily stored away and it conditions the hair VERY well.  It heats evenly all the way around and leaves my hair moisturized down to the hair cuticle. This thing barely gets warm a waste of money for me. If you have thick hair forget about it. My other heat cap lasted 25 years and used to get hot on high. They don’t make anything like they used to.

I like that it has three heat settings. Unfortunately, it didn't get very hot and it didn't stay consistently hot. I could feel some warmth on my head, but by the time it starts to feel warm, it cools down. Using the high heat setting felt more like low. Using the low heat setting would have just made me mad. I've only used it once since receiving it but it heated up very well and my whole head was covered and got conditioned.  This is so much better than sitting under the hood hair dryer for conditioner treatments where the back of my head never got enough heat.  And I love having a timer that automatically cuts off when the time is up.  Plus the cord was long enough to allow me to move around a bit or sit in a chair and read.  Conditioning at home is much better than paying extra at the hair salon.

reviews.t: Well worth the price!  Yes, it works well!
reviews.x: I wondered about the reviews but this thing works.  Plugged it in and tried all three settings.  It works perfectly.  I actually found it soothing.  It heated all over as would be expected.  I will be using low or medium because my hair is a little fragile.  I thought the high heat really got very warm.  This is something I wish I'd bought a long time ago.  The cord was longer than I expected too.  The picture doesn't reflect size of cap or length of chord very well.  Both are generous in size a

Used the product for the first time today. Set it for the highest temperature, and went about deep conditioning my hair.  The cap covered my head completely from forehead to nape and still had space. All areas were properly heated. I'm not a person who likes high heat on my head or hair and the heat generated at the high temperature was moderate.  Which may not be warm enough for some person but it was fine for me. Overall I'm happy with the item. Will have  see if it withstands the test of time

While I can appreciate the convenience of a heating cap (versus a hooded dryer), this does not get as hot as I would've hoped, even after pre-heating for two minutes as the manufacturer suggests. The fit is not as snug as advertised, particularly in the back, which means you cannot feel the heat around the entirety of your head.  In addition, the chin straps are uncomfortable and do not provide the tightness and security in an easy-to-tie format as I expected.

Like this item, however, it does not heat-up quickly ,nor evenly with the given time frame on the instructions. I had to keep it on for 40 mins to feel the effects of it. Too much of the heat gets wasted in the pointed area of the top. I can work with it as long as the electrical aspects keep working..

reviews.t: I feel like the cap doesn't come down far enough
reviews.x: Thought it would get a little hotter. Plus with natural hair, I feel like the cap doesn't come down far enough. But my hair gets soft so I guess it's good enough, hence the 3 stars.

reviews.t: Really Like This Cap, One small change I'd like to see
reviews.x: This is probably one of the best processing caps to get.  Why?  It pretty much fits your whole head unlike some others that are odd-shaped.  Has very even heat compared to other caps - it is a bit cooler around the seams (which should be expected).  I like the timer, don't have to sit and watch the clock and wonder "is that when I started?".  3 heat settings and I've used it on high with no problem when using with Malibu Crystal Gel Treatment.  The only thing I'd change is the strap.  It

reviews.t: Gets the job done, but its just large heat coils in a cap.
reviews.x: The product itself works fine. On the highest temps the heat still mild. It works just enough to give you a decent deep conditioner and get a nice sweat going. Other than that it's just the normal coils you can buy as "hand warmers" for pennies put into a cap with a voltage regulator attached to it. It doesn't get hot enough to explode batteries or harm electronics which is great as I can pop on some DJ headphones over it (or wear waterproof earbuds) and enjoy some entertainment while I'm waitin

Usually I research a lot before buying a product and this is my favorite heat cap. It's already the second one I buy from Milliard. I like the fact that I can just plug it in the outlet so it gets warmer and there's a timer to turn it off, easy and practical. The strap can be a little frail, but all the rest is really sturdy and works great. Also, great customer service. I was gladly surprised when they asked my opinion about the product by email and really heard and addressed my comments. Will

I was skeptical about buying this cap due to mixed reviews, but I went ahead and got it anyway. Some people have commented that it doesn’t get hot enough, and I can see why. Generally there’s not a super tight fit and the cap is thin. To help insulate and keep the heat in I wrap a towel over the cap while it’s on my head.  Works for me!

reviews.t: Does not heat up all over
reviews.x: This cap only heats up on top and the right side. The back doesn't come in contact with hair by the nape of the neck so there's no conditioning effect back there. I've had it for awhile and the left side has stopped getting hot.  No worth the $.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the cap heats up well and fast, covering the whole head for effective deep conditioning.
A common complaint is that the cap does not get hot enough or heats unevenly, especially for thick hair.
Reviewers frequently praise it as a cost-effective, convenient alternative to salon hooded dryers.
Some buyers received defective or seemingly used units, though customer service offered refunds or replacements.
Users appreciate the multiple heat settings and automatic timer feature.
